correctness.rationale: The Pauli XX+YY+ZZ action on the single-excitation basis equals twice the cycle adjacency, with zero diagonal; its two opposite-momentum modes have eigenvalue zero. A normalized superposition has site probabilities p_j=(1+2(-1)^j Re(a conj(b)))/4. Since the one-site density is diag(1-p_j,p_j), Brennen’s average-purity identity gives Q=1-Σp_j²=3/4-Re(a conj(b))². Because |Re(a conj(b))|≤1/2 and every intermediate magnitude is achievable, the range is exact. The endpoint |1000>-|0010> normalized has Q=1/2 while momentum waves have Q=3/4. The independent exact fraction endpoint check agrees, but the continuous formula comes from algebra, not enumeration. This is not a contradiction to the source plane-wave computation; it refutes the unqualified statement about every energy eigenvector in a degenerate eigenspace.
